name: The Fresh-Break Window
summary: The only resource in the setting that is worthless before its owner is. A dao fragment cures as it decays and a cured fragment is void crystal, so value falls with time on the tier's ten-to-hundred-times clock and a holder with no buyer is holding a liability - which makes the only rational holder of the shelf whoever can sell into the future.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:geography.fragmentshelf decays_into void_crystal + geography.void_expanse monotonic supply + geography.fragment_ring single_substrate
abstract-pattern:maturing mineral with an unavoidable conversion tail
lore search fragment / shelf / void crystal returned no prior economy record

attributes.decay_product: void_crystal, monotonic, growing every period, unslowable, and therefore uncornerable
attributes.unit_of_account: hours of freshness, not weight. Nobody has ever agreed a weight for a fragment because the number is wrong by the time it is spoken, and a market that quotes a decaying good in a stable unit is quoting the cured price
attributes.the_deadline: one generation of curing at 10-100x. A working lifetime and a market lifetime are the same length here, which happens nowhere else in the setting and is the whole of this rung's economics
attributes.why_not_a_monopoly: a guaranteed and unbounded supply of the cured form means there is nothing to gain by controlling the ground. The only thing worth holding is the fresh end of a wound, and the ground itself is worth nothing
attributes.competing_use: geography.fragment_ring has to stand on the same shelf because broken law is the only substrate that can host a self larger than its body, so the mine and the trial compete for the same square metres and neither can be moved
attributes.what_it_cannot_buy: a permanent crossing. The Eighteenth Bed proved that a seat cannot be held by someone who cannot pay for it every period, and no quantity of fragments changes that, because the price of holding is time rather than money

name: The Ford Dues
summary: A toll paid in grain, two parts at the crossing and one part against the winter, and it is the March's entire obligation line. It exists because the Widow Run moves its bed far enough between floods to relocate every settlement on it, so the useful service is re-finding the crossing rather than maintaining it - and because a toll denominated in the payer's own crop cannot be inflated by the collector.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:claim_march obligation ford_dues=2 winter_grain=1 + geography.widow_run bed_movement + geography.bitter_scrub three_uses
abstract-pattern:in-kind crossing tolls where the collector farms the same field
lore search ford / dues / toll returned no prior economy record

attributes.why_grain: the plains grow herb_common and almost nothing else worth carrying, so a grain toll is the only denomination in which the payer and the payee both survive a bad year
attributes.the_counter_inflation_property: a collector cannot raise a grain toll and gain, because the collector eats from the same field. On a tier whose only export is a crowd, this is the only price control available and it is structural rather than administered
attributes.what_it_pays_for: nothing visible. The obligation settles and the line closes, and there is no office behind it, no seat attached to it and no project it funds that anybody has to report on
attributes.who_refuses_to_pay: the ferry-houses whose own boat is the crossing, which is precisely why the March's authority is exercised at a ford and never at a farm. The polity's power and its largest debtors are the same people
attributes.not_a_seat: settling this term moves standing and never writes a position, so an unpaid ford can make a polity less recognised and can never make it differently governed
attributes.re-fixed_each_flood: the terms are re-fixed every flood and published at both landings the same day, because a toll quoted at one bank is a toll the other bank will lie about

name: The Gale Window
summary: A crossing schedule set by the Tidemark season rather than by the holder's preference, which is the only arrangement that makes a toll defensible and a timetable not. It exists because the spirit tier writes spatial and temporal law, so a pass can be surveyed and closed and reopened on a published date - and because a flock occupies the worst hours of it.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:geography.gale_pass schedulable, toll mechanism set by the Tidemark season + ecology.gale_pass_swift co-holder + cosmology.qi_tide
abstract-pattern:orographic passes with a fixed seasonal crossing quota
lore search window / quota / gale returned no prior economy record

attributes.published: a season ahead, and it may be shortened never
attributes.co_holder: ecology.gale_pass_swift. The flock crosses in the season the gale is worst and occupies the only usable hours for part of the window, so the holder's quota is partly set by an animal nobody negotiated with
attributes.what_it_is_not: not a closed door. A window is a schedule and a schedule can be planned around in a way a prohibition cannot, which is why the jade workers keep working through the bad hours instead of leaving
attributes.why_the_holder_does_not_set_it: a holder who sets the date sets a claim on the weather, and weather is the one thing in this setting nobody has ever successfully claimed. The schedule is published precisely so that no party can later say the window was moved for them
attributes.losers_if_closed: the jade workers and the fire practitioners, who have no alternative route. Their lack of a second road is the entire reason the pass is worth holding and the reason the holder's tariff is collectable
attributes.unit: hours in a season, counted on the Tidemark and never on a holder's clock
attributes.the_quotas_stone_equivalent: one cut length of fresh spirit stone is the unit this window is quoted in, which makes the schedule and the price the same number viewed from two sides

name: The Cairn Gate Fee
summary: The admission charge to watch a breakthrough the tier itself is not licensed to attempt. It exists because the Mortal Plains hosts all nine mortal-band trials and licenses no humanoid to attempt one, so the crowd is the only export a resource-poor tier has, and the gate fees are the only tax the plains can actually collect.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:geography.cairn_field spectator_economy, local_practitioners 0, gate fees the only tax the plains can collect
abstract-pattern:entrance charges to an event a region hosts but cannot supply
lore search gate / fee / tax returned no prior economy record

attributes.fee_not_toll: a toll is paid for passage and a fee for standing still. The plains cannot tax a passage nobody makes, but they can tax a crowd that comes to watch, which makes this the only instrument the tier owns
attributes.what_it_buys: grain, tools and the granary, and nothing else. There is no alternative revenue on this tier, which is why the fee is set by a chartered town rather than by anybody with standing to set it
attributes.the_honest_problem: a crowd that comes to watch a trial it is not licensed to attempt has no stake in the outcome, so this is the only economic relationship on the mortal tier with no obligation on either side. It is also the tier's most reliable one
attributes.who_pays_more: everybody. The local households are spectators too and are not exempt from their own town's gate, which is the single clearest sign that no one on this tier is a resident of it
attributes.what_it_cannot_buy: a place on the trials. The ring's roster is closed by law and not by fee, so the gate is a door onto an event and not a lottery for it
attributes.why_it_is_legible_every_year: ecology.trial_field_lichen leaves a pale patch wherever a large quantity of qi has been drawn through worked stone, so attendance is countable after the fact from above. A tax that can be audited by lichen is the only kind this tier can survive

name: The Immortal Essence Pool
summary: The first resource in the ladder priced by period rather than by weight, because at the immortal tier upkeep rises about fortyfold and a mortal lifespan inside this world is a rounding error. Essence is not bought, it is settled every period, and the fact that it must be paid continuously is what produces this tier's entire creditor class.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:history.era_the_broken_bridge upkeep_after 1.0-5.0 + history.collapse_the_eighteenth_bed + geography.immortal_court
abstract-pattern:tier economies where upkeep rather than lifespan is the binding constraint
lore search essence / upkeep / creditor returned no prior economy record

attributes.priced_in: periods. cosmology.temporal_law reads to 50x at this tier, so a weight would be a lie about how long the holder will still be alive. The unit of this rung is a body's own upkeep for a stated number of periods
attributes.why_scarce: not scarcity of supply but scarcity of payers. The cost is continuous and it is claimed in arrears, which is exactly what broke the Eighteenth Bed crossing and is why no sect has ever held a permanent border
attributes.what_it_prices: every office on the Terrace of Nine Seats, because a seat that cannot be paid for is not a seat. It is also the reason the four vacant immortal seats are attractive: unfilled capacity pays its own upkeep
attributes.the_lender_class: anybody holding an unexpired claim on a body that is drawing on it. There is no lender in this setting who holds anything but an obligation line, which is why this tier has no banks and has usurers
attributes.the_cap_that_stops_corruption: an institution may not convert an essence debt into power. Debt is an open term on a claim and an open term is never a position, so the most expensive thing in the setting cannot buy the cheapest office in it
attributes.failure_mode: a debt claimed in arrears and never released, which is history.collapse_the_eighteenth_bed, and the residue of it is a bed of unusable seats at realm eighteen

name: The Iron Ore Bed
summary: The mortal tier's only dense material, and the only thing on this tier a body can be caged in. It is scarce for two compounding reasons: the seam is worked out, and a world with no spatial law cannot open a fresh one - so exhaustion here is permanent rather than a supply problem, and every price below the ridge hangs off how much of it is still in the ground.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:history.era_the_gilded_core governing_resource iron_ore + history.disaster_the_iron_grief + geography.ironhead_flats
abstract-pattern:ore bodies with no spatial law and therefore no new workings
lore search ore / iron / scarcity returned no prior economy record

attributes.why_scarce: history.disaster_the_iron_grief: one exhausted seam cost the tier its whole remaining ladder, because a core has to be caged in something and a three-slot world cannot re-cut stone to find more. The scarcity is not a rate of consumption; it is a closed total with no mechanism for adding to it
attributes.unit_of_account: weight at the face. The weight at the face is not the weight at the road, because ore is heavy and roads are not, and every price difference between the two is haulage rather than margin
attributes.what_it_prices: every craft, tool, container and weapon on the plains, and the arming of the only standing garrison on the tier
attributes.never_priced_in: its own exhaustion. The market on the plains has no instrument for a good that may end entirely, so the last of it is not expensive - it is unobtainable, and those are different states
attributes.substitute: none at this tier. The next material that will cage a body is spirit stone, and it cannot be found below the spirit tier, so the ladder has no rung between
attributes.the_only_hire_work_it_creates: moving the spoil, because ecology.iron_scar_soil has not dispersed in four decades and the working face cannot advance under a heap that nothing on this tier can shift

name: The Cleft Ration
summary: The food contract that actually holds the Jade Cleft, because jade holds qi and will not grow a crop. It exists because the cleft is the spirit tier's best refinement ground and its worst farming ground, so whoever provisions the workers owns the mine more durably than whoever digs it - and because the road in is one pass somebody else schedules.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:geography.jade_cleft agriculture none, access gale_pass only + ecology.jade_seam_draft gradient + ecology.jade_cleft_moss maps the seam
abstract-pattern:company towns contingent on a third party's logistics
lore search ration / cleft / provisioning returned no prior economy record

attributes.supplies: everything, into a place that grows nothing
attributes.consumers: everybody working a gradient, which on ecology.jade_seam_draft means a falling series of thin and increasingly deep workings rather than one large mine
attributes.why_food_beats_mining: a mine can be abandoned and re-worked by whoever arrives next, and a hunger cannot. Provisioning is therefore the durable party and mining is the intermittent one, which inverts the usual reading of who owns a mineral district
attributes.the_renewal_pressure: the holdfast's charter expires when the food does, and that is the only calendar a non-agricultural settlement has. There is no planting season here, so there is no calendar that does not arrive in someone else's cart
attributes.the_moss_problem: cutting the jade is also grazing the seam. ecology.jade_cleft_moss maps the gradient because it only grows where the seam holds qi, so a working face is a bare patch - working faster destroys the map needed to find the next face, which is the only instance in this setting where extraction destroys its own exploration data
attributes.what_it_cannot_buy: the pass. A ration contract is a supply relationship and the pass is a schedule, and no quantity of food moves a Tidemark, so the provisioner of the cleft can be starved by a window that closes on a published date

name: The Four-Rung Price
summary: The conversion that lets anybody price anything across four tiers where time runs between half a hundred and a hundred times a mortal's, without ever computing a rate. It exists because a figure quoted in one tier's weights is meaningless in the next, and because the setting's only universally accepted medium is passage - which is denominated in a body rather than in a coin.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:history.founding_the_first_tier seat_cost_curve + history.era_the_broken_bridge upkeep + cosmology.realm_band tier bands
abstract-pattern:non-convertible price ladders between stacked economies
lore search currency / valuation / price returned no prior economy record

attributes.the_ladder: iron_ore, then spirit_stone, then immortal_essence, then dao_fragment - with herb_common, jade_ore, star_metal and void_crystal running beside them as the goods each tier actually trades
attributes.the_rung: one rung is a quantity of a body that will still be the same body one period later at the tier where it is quoted. That definition is what makes a rung comparable across tiers at all
attributes.why_no_arithmetic: each rung is quoted and never derived, because the tiers differ by a fortyfold upkeep step and a clock that runs up to a hundred times faster, and no single formula survives both without a law this setting does not have. A derived rate would be a claim about a world nobody has surveyed
attributes.what_is_not_a_rung: standing. A claim is recognised and never priced, which is why the whole political surface of the setting is uncorruptible by money and equally unbuyable - the two facts are the same fact
attributes.the_unit_of_control: passage, the only supply chain whose unit is a person
attributes.the_prohibition: a seat may not be levied, so no price on this ladder ever buys a position, and no position on it ever sets a price. The prohibition is what makes the ladder legible across four tiers instead of four separate markets
attributes.what_a_wage_is: one rung's worth of a mortal's upkeep, which on the plains is a share of grain and on the ridge is a cut length. A wage is therefore a statement about which tier the labour happens on
attributes.what_breaks_the_ladder: nothing between tiers. There is no exchange rate, because a conversion that requires two bodies to survive the crossing is not an exchange rate - it is the crossing tariff

name: The Crossing Tariff
summary: The only durable wealth in the setting, because it is the only thing anybody can actually control between tiers. It exists because the cost of existing rises about fortyfold per tier and only a body can be moved, so the count of who may pass became the one controllable supply chain - and because a central prohibition keeps it from ever becoming a market in offices.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:history.discovery_the_passage_ledger unit_of_control passage, unit_of_payment one body's own upkeep, central_prohibition a seat may not be levied
abstract-pattern:crossing levies as the only asset in a tier-divided world
lore search tariff / levy / passage returned no prior economy record

attributes.unit_of_payment: one body's own upkeep. The payer pays for the body that arrives, not for the cargo, and a cargo can therefore cross for nothing if nobody is in it
attributes.unit_of_control: permission to pass, which is the only supply chain in the setting whose unit is a person
attributes.holders: the Marshal closes the fords; the counting houses answer access with a ledger of who may use the roads, at what rate, on whose word. Neither of them owns the roads and both of them profit from the answer
attributes.the_prohibition: a seat may not be levied. No tariff line ever converts into an office and no office ever sets a tariff line, so the richest institution in this setting still cannot buy the cheapest office in it - which is the single most load-bearing economic rule here
attributes.what_makes_it_durable: the tariff survives the death of the holder, because the crossing outlives whoever stood at it. This is the only asset class in the setting with that property
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: it cannot be levied on a body already drawing on an essence debt, so the top two rungs of the ladder are untariffed by design. Above the spirit tier the tariff stops being the wealth it was, because upkeep has already taken the body's future
attributes.refusal_and_price_are_different_states: a crossing refused is a refused entry and a crossing charged is a price. The two are kept apart because a refusal can be appealed and a price cannot, and a single number covering both would make an appeal into a negotiation
attributes.denomination: grain, salt and labour hours on the plains; weight at the pass; nothing stateable in the unlisted anchorage, which is the only reason that community can afford the road at all

name: The Unwritten Count
summary: A currency that is not a medium at all: one member of each counting house keeps the real figures in their head, unrecorded, because a house that files everything cannot be left alone. It exists because the counting houses answer the Saltledger's access with a ledger, and a house with nothing written has nothing to seize, nothing to cite and nothing to lose in a raid.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:cultures.quiet_count whole practice + organizations.saltledger publishes credit against exclusivity + organizations.quiethouse discretion for silence
abstract-pattern:deliberately unrecorded accounting as an independence strategy
lore search currency / ledger / count returned no prior economy record

attributes.medium: none. The unit is a remembered figure, and it is held by exactly one person per house
attributes.holder: one member per house, wearing no mark at all, because any marker would convert an invisible authority into a visible office that anybody could apply for
attributes.what_it_buys: not goods. It buys the house's independence, and it is the only asset in the setting that survives being taken by force - which is the whole reason a house that answers a carriage trade with prices at its own rates cannot tolerate a business that keeps no prices
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: settle a dispute between two houses. Neither will state a figure, so every cross-house settlement is by weight, by inspection, or by standing name - which is why a court on this tier can hear a boundary case and cannot hear an account
attributes.the_cost: the count takes the holder's working life, it cannot be taught faster than it can be learned, and a house that loses one person loses its currency entirely. That is the reason the office has no marker: it cannot be inherited and cannot be advertised
attributes.why_it_exists_against_pressure: a counting house that answers a trade with prices at its own rates cannot enumerate a trade whose good is unrecorded, so concealment became the price of continued independence - and cultures.unfiled is what that pressure produced at the level of a whole community
attributes.relation_to_a_currency: a currency with a fixed supply of one holder per house and no issuer, which is exactly why it is equally unbuyable and unborrowable. Nothing can be lent into it and nothing can be taken out

name: The Bitter Common
summary: The mortal tier's only herb, which is medicine, feed and calories at once, on ground that cannot be fenced and does not come back faster than it is grazed. It exists because a three-slot world spends its life seat on exactly what a plant needs and nothing more, so the tier's only remedy is also its most contested mouthful.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:geography.bitter_scrub three_uses, fencing impossible + ecology.scrub_grazing_press + cosmology.mortal_law_availability spends life_law on a plant
abstract-pattern:multi-use commons under livestock pressure in a seasonal-free climate
lore search commons / herb / grazing returned no prior economy record

attributes.why_unfenceable: the scrub is wider than any one household's need and narrower than a pasture, so a fence is a hole in the commons and is treated as one. There is no arrangement here that improves the commons without making it worse, which is the definition rather than an observation about it
attributes.regrowth: grazing pressure, not weather. Nothing on this tier is seasonally dormant because elemental law is unspent, so there is no bad season and only a bad year of grazing
attributes.the_failure_order: a bad grazing year is a medical shortage before it is a hunger, because the medicine is fed to the animals first. Every death on this tier from want is a death from the medicine being eaten
attributes.who_grazes_first: grazers, always, and the herds are larger than the households. The commons therefore has no defender except the people who can do without it, which is nobody
attributes.the_tiers_only_remedy: a mortal body's dependable remedy is grown on ground livestock would rather have, and herb_common is the only plant in the authored resource list at this tier. There is no substitute and no import, because there is no ladder rung below iron
attributes.what_it_prices: almost nothing, because almost nothing here is bought. It prices survival, which is not a market - and the tier's one genuine export is a crowd, so the common feeds a population that never appears in any price

name: The Spirit Stone Bed
summary: The first resource that makes a breakthrough schedulable rather than merely attempted, because spirit stone holds qi and a qi tide is the only way a strained law ever reads as a common one. It is scarce for a geological reason with a political cost: it lies in the same bedding as jade ore, so a claim on stone is a claim on jade and a claim on the only pass over the ridge.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:geography.spiritscar_quarry + geography.sixfold_ridge + history.consequence_the_density_ceiling + cosmology.qi_tide
abstract-pattern:ore bodies sold against a tide calendar
lore search stone / spirit stone / jade returned no prior economy record

attributes.why_scarce: history.consequence_the_density_ceiling: the measured stone left per unit of ground worked has been falling for three generations, and the densest bodies in the setting stop at realm seventeen, one gate short of the end of their own tier. Nobody has explained the ceiling and everybody is affected by it
attributes.who_benefits_from_the_ceiling: anybody holding a working face. That is the whole reason the only verifiable institution in this tier has an interest in a hole nobody can look into, and the reason the measured figure is published before any sale rather than after
attributes.unit_of_account: a cut length, not a weight. The stone is cut to length because a length is what a refinement chamber takes, and a tier that sells by length sells by the shape of the buyer
attributes.what_it_prices: the Sixth Seat Grounds' entire trial calendar, the Jade Holdfast's refinement, and every technique that runs at full strength below this tier and produces nothing
attributes.price_anchor: one length of fresh stone is the unit the Gale Pass window is quoted in, so the pass's schedule is in substance a stone price, and a holder who claims not to know the price is claiming not to know the schedule
attributes.nobody_may_sell_the_answer: a figure published before the sale cannot be disputed after it, which is the only enforcement mechanism the quarry has and the reason the assay floor is neutral ground

name: The Spoil Hauler
summary: A whole profession that exists because a law is absent: the heap at the Exhausted Seam has stood on the ore that is gone for four decades because spatial law is unspent on the plains, so nothing carries it away and the working face cannot advance underneath it. It is the only remaining ore-costly job on the tier, which makes the people who do it the only workers here whose labour is genuinely scarce.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:ecology.iron_scar_soil four decades unmoved + geography.exhausted_seam what_the_spoil_blocks + cosmology.unwritten_law spatial absent signature
abstract-pattern:manual remediation labour created by absent infrastructure
lore search spoil / hauler / profession returned no prior economy record

attributes.job: moving the spoil so the working face can advance
attributes.why_the_heap_exists: ecology.iron_scar_soil: spoil that has not moved in four decades, because a world with no spatial law cannot change its own size and therefore cannot relocate what it has produced. The heap is the visible proof of the absence and it is also the thing preventing new work
attributes.why_it_is_ore_costly: the only tools on this tier are iron tools and a hauler spends them on moving material that pays nothing. It is the one job where the worker's tools are consumed by the cleanup rather than by the product
attributes.scarcity_of_the_profession: genuine. Every other trade on the plains can be done by a household with a plough and a roof; this one cannot be done by anyone who has not been taught the lift, and there is no school for it
attributes.what_they_are_paid_in: shares of the face rather than wages, which is why haulers argue about the face and never about rates. A rate would make the job a wage and the wage would make it a household trade
attributes.the_unfairness: the hauler removes the evidence of exhaustion and in doing so makes exhaustion invisible again. It is why the quarry at the top of the ladder keeps its hole open and publishable and this one cannot afford to
attributes.who_can_do_it: anyone with a body. The tier licenses no humanoid, so every hauler on the plains is a visitor, none of them lives here, and the profession is therefore staffed entirely from outside by a polity that produces nobody

name: The Standing Weight
summary: A second currency that also refuses to state a price, for the opposite reason to the first: the counting houses conceal because enumeration is leverage, and this one conceals because a price is a claim about the future. It exists because a Void Serpent in any quantity was worth more than the ship carrying it, and a people that declined to price its most profitable cargo was never worth raiding.

provenance.author: w3-economy
basis: authored-game-data:cultures.weight_and_name cause, taboos, festivals, architecture + history.migration_the_peak_ascent
abstract-pattern:refusal-to-price as a deterrence strategy in extractive trade
lore search weight / price / standing name returned no prior economy record

attributes.medium: weight. The unit is mass, and the community's vocabulary contains no word for price
attributes.the_standing_name: the one term that covers every commercial arrangement this culture has ever made, including the two-household contracts whose right to weigh passes to the pair
attributes.why_no_price_list: a price is a claim about the future and a weight is a fact about the present. A people holding a good that outvalues its own shipping cannot safely assert what it is worth, because the assertion would be the first thing anyone used to justify taking it
attributes.the_first_offer_rule: nobody makes the first offer, so a buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing in the market for a season. The market polices itself and there is no office behind it, which is why no institution in this community could be captured by making itself useful
attributes.why_it_survived_a_collapse: a Void Serpent's law values write a number that cannot be recorded, so what this settlement abandoned was the ledger and not the trade. That is the one collapse in the setting that was caused by arithmetic rather than by appetite
attributes.what_it_guarantees: a hull's design is the legal statement that nothing on board is registered anywhere, which every other port reads as a promise of its own honesty. The decoration is the credit rating and it is untransferable
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: be levied, taxed or quoted in a tariff, because no one will state the figure. That is exactly why this community is the only road the Unfiled can afford, and why the tariff at a pass quoted in weight rather than value is the arrangement that made them reachable at all
